search[T: Ghul.Comparable[T]](values: T[], sought: T) -> int? is

    let high mut = values.count - 1

use IO.Std.write_line

search[T: Ghul.Comparable[T]](values: T[], sought: T) -> int? is
    let low mut = 0
    let high mut = values.count - 1

    while low <= high do
        let middle = low + (high - low) / 2

        if values[middle] =~ sought then
            return middle
        elif values[middle] < sought then
            low = middle + 1
        else
            high = middle - 1
        fi
    od

    null
si

let haystack = [1, 3, 4, 7, 11, 18, 29, 47, 76]

for needle in [7, 47, 8] do
    if let at = search(haystack, needle) then
        write_line("{needle} is at index {at}")
    else
        write_line("{needle} is not present")
    fi
